findings: The APOB p.(Pro955Ser) variant showed reduced LDL internalization efficiency in hepatocytes compared to healthy controls.
Homozygous p.(Pro955Ser) variants exhibited significantly lower uptake than heterozygous variants (p<0.01).
The variant's effect size was moderate (OR=4.9, 95% CI: 3.4–7.1).
rationale: The variant demonstrated functional impairment in hepatocyte assays and was statistically enriched in FH patients.
experimental_details: LDL internalization measured via fluorescence intensity after 30-min incubation at 37°C (n=3 replicates). Compared homozygous/heterozygous p.(Pro955Ser), pathogenic p.(Arg3527Gln), and healthy controls.
p1_source_location: Fig. 2 legend (3.4% allele frequency in Japan)
p2_source_location: Fig. 2 legend (9.8% prevalence in FH probands)
